# dify_api_tool_provider (Resource)

Manages an API tool provider — an OpenAPI-schema-backed custom tool provider keyed by name. Changing `name` renames the provider in place. Credential values are write-only: describe returns them masked, so state keeps the configured values. Import by name: `terraform import dify_api_tool_provider.x <name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register a custom tool provider from an OpenAPI schema document.
resource "dify_api_tool_provider" "open_meteo" {
  name = "open_meteo"
  icon = {
    content    = "⛅"
    background = "#E0F2FE"
  }
  schema_type = "openapi"
  schema      = file("${path.module}/openapi.json")
  credentials = { auth_type = "none" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `icon` (Attributes) Emoji tile the workspace shows for the provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icon))
- `name` (String) Provider name; changing it renames the provider in place.
- `schema` (String) The schema text (an OpenAPI document) that defines the provider's tools.

### Optional

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) Auth configuration the provider's calls send (e.g. `{auth_type = "none"}`). Write-only and sensitive; state keeps the configured values.
- `custom_disclaimer` (String) Custom disclaimer shown to users of the provider's tools.
- `labels` (List of String) Tool labels for the provider.
- `privacy_policy` (String) Privacy policy URL.
- `schema_type` (String) Schema type (`openapi`, `swagger`, `openai_plugin`, `openai_actions`).

### Read-Only

- `tools` (List of String) Names of the tools the schema defines.

<a id="nestedatt--icon"></a>
### Nested Schema for `icon`

Required:

- `background` (String) Tile background color (e.g. `#252525`).
- `content` (String) Emoji content (e.g. `🌤`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# API tool providers are imported by provider name.
terraform import dify_api_tool_provider.example <name>
```
